therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: mTOR inhibition combined with aromatase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: inhibition of tumor cell proliferation and estrogen synthesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Chinese postmenopausal women with estrogen receptor positive, locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic breast cancer after progression on non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-free survival based on local radiology review

results.target_engagement_evidence: Everolimus steady-state concentrations achieved: Cmin 16.5 ng/mL, C2h 44.2 ng/mL
biomarker_changes: Estradiol levels decreased from baseline to week 4 in both arms (everolimus+exemestane: 5.98 to 3.98 pg/mL; placebo+exemestane: 5.38 to 3.77 pg/mL)
results.dose_information: Everolimus 10 mg daily (two 5 mg tablets), Exemestane 25 mg daily, continuous oral dosing

context.duration: Treatment up to approximately 3.5 years, follow-up up to approximately 3.8 years
